The step's layout is the thing it teaches.

step.title: Put a line and a bar chart side by side
step.instructions: In rain.ipynb, make fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4)) so the two axes sit in one row. Draw the monthly rainfall as a line on ax1 and as bars on ax2, and give the figure one title with fig.suptitle('Monthly rainfall').

cells.source:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun']
rain = [78, 61, 55, 47, 52, 39]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 4))
ax1.plot(months, rain, marker='o')
ax2.bar(months, rain)
fig.suptitle('Monthly rainfall')
